lede: TG Auto is a car workshop at Premier@Kaki Bukit. Its own website says it specialises in Mercedes-Benz and BMW cars, with repairs, engine overhauls, diagnosis, bodywork, insurance claims and ECU performance tuning.
services: Aircon, brakes, tyres and wheel alignment
themes: Customers on Google Maps mention a friendly boss who explains what is needed without pushing extra repairs, cost-effective fixes, a brake fluid change, and scratch removal and paint work on a BMW.
faqs: Google Maps lists it as a car repair workshop.
The hours are listed in the Google Maps section above. Please see Google Maps for current hours.
services_note: Services as listed on the workshop's own website, tgauto.com.sg.
makes_note: Named on its own website, which says it accepts all makes and models.
good_to_know: Same-day service for most repairs and maintenance, according to its website
